question: Should Comfy `workflowPath` files above 16 MiB be rejected as an intentional supported compatibility boundary?
rationale: The patch converts previously accepted oversized local configuration files into a fail-closed error; source-level correctness does not establish whether that upgrade behavior is acceptable for existing Comfy workflows.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
options.body: Land the bounded reader with the current focused proof if maintainers consider oversized workflow files unsupported.

options.title: Adjust the compatibility contract
options.body: Choose and validate a different ceiling or migration/documentation path if legitimate shipped workflows can exceed 16 MiB.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the bounded reader with the current focused proof if maintainers consider oversized workflow files unsupported.
